Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_PROTECTOR_ST
Description: Determines the parameters for reinforcing armor.

Fields.Name: Physical Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Physical defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Magic Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Magic defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Fire Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Fire defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Lightning Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Lightning defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Slash Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Slash defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Strike Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Strike defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Thrust Defense (x)
Fields.Description: Thrust defense at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, 2 means double.

Fields.Name: Poison Resistance (x)
Fields.Description: Poison resistance at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, higher resists more.

Fields.Name: Toxic Resistance (x)
Fields.Description: Toxic resistance at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, higher resists more.

Fields.Name: Bleed Resistance (x)
Fields.Description: Bleed resistance at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, higher resists more.

Fields.Name: Curse Resistance (x)
Fields.Description: Curse resistance at this upgrade level, compared with the unupgraded armor. 1 means unchanged, higher resists more.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 1
Fields.Description: Moves the armor's first wearer effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 2
Fields.Description: Moves the armor's second wearer effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect Offset: 3
Fields.Description: Moves the armor's third wearer effect up its list at this upgrade level, usually to a stronger form. 0 keeps the base effect.

Fields.Name: Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Which upgrade stones this level needs, as a step up from the armor's base list. 0 keeps the base list.
